en.summary: The Seoul of the time was not a flat administrative map but a graph of stations, tunnels, and sluices.

en.text: The Seoul of the time was not a flat administrative map but a graph of stations, tunnels, and sluices. Even in 2026 people crossed gu by subway, and the treatment centers and depots sat as the heavy nodes of that graph. On the night of the

, when remote control died, stations became fortresses and the centers of states, tunnels became licensed passage, and treatment plants and sluices became lock gates that opened only under signature. A century on, the sixteen states of 2126 read those points and lines as living spheres and never changed gu names into state names.

ko.text: 2026년 서울 사람들은 지하철로 구를 넘었고 정수센터와 차량기지도 역과 터널에 연결되어 있었다.
의 밤에 원격 관제가 멈추었다. 이후 역은 요새이자 나라의 중심지가 되었으며 터널 통행에는 허가가 필요해졌다. 정수장과 수문은 서명이 있어야 열렸다. 2126년 십육국은 역과 터널과 수문을 생활권으로 관리하되 구 이름을 국호로 쓰지 않는다.

en.text: A station brought people, facilities, and connections back into use. In a dong with a subway station, the station building was the core facility; distribution, passage tolls, lodging, and refuge were handled there. Schools, community centers, and hospitals supported it. After the March 14, 2053 agreement, the Yeouido houses managed eleven water facilities around Yeongdeungpo Station. From 2106, passes for Jongno and Junggu carried the Government Seoul Complex stamp from Gwanghwamun. Amsa Station administered water and escort protection from its platform. Sindorim was the bottleneck between Yeongdeungpo and Guro, while Suseo held a southern depot and contract administration. The parties and signatures of the 2053 agreement were recorded in

The concourse carried markets, habitation, and administration; the platforms movement, defense, and freight; the transfers the politics between lines and the seat of transit tolls. text.en: In 2106, Jongno and Junggu passes and commercial contracts received a Government Seoul Complex stamp. A counterfeit medicine box appeared at a Seoul Station auction in 2124.
text.ko: 종로·중구 통행증과 상거래 계약서는 2106년부터 정부서울청사 도장을 받았다. 2124년 서울역에서는 가짜 약 상자가 경매에 올랐다.

text.en: Between station and station lay lines that were never erased. Only the states changed — normal, hazardous, controlled, blockaded, flooded, collapsed, provisional repair — and cause and repair conditions followed. Yeongdeungpo–Sindorim and Sindorim–Guro were adjacencies the current map already knew, and no line skipped Yeongdeungpo–Guro in one cell. The full catalog's adjacencies went up as design data as 435 drawn from map points.
text.ko: 역 사이의 선로는 연결을 유지한다. 정상·위험·통제·봉쇄·침수·붕괴·임시 복구 중 상태가 바뀌며 원인과 복구 조건을 기록한다. 영등포—신도림과 신도림—구로는 지도에 있는 인접이다. 영등포—구로를 건너뛰는 선은 없다. 전체 카탈로그의 인접 435개는 지도 점에서 뽑은 설계 자료다.

text.en: Machines repeat their last search and guard routines on surviving tracks, while rats nest in cable trays beneath transfer concourses. The track connections remain as they were in 2026.

text.en: Depot area was the normal-time memory of rolling stock and maintenance; post-collapse operating volume was creative. The measured names within Seoul were eight: Sinjeong, Cheonwang, Banghwa, Gunja, Godeok, Changdong, Sinnae, and Suseo. The Water Compact corresponded to Sinjeong, the Standards Alliance to Cheonwang, the Escort Protection State to Godeok, and the Neutral Convoy City to Sinnae. Banghwa, Gunja, Changdong, and Suseo were no state's capital depot but remained unclaimed or edge corridors. They were the seats emptied of the Magok research, Ttukseom workshops, Changdong wheels, and Suseo protection capitals. Jichuk, Dobong, Moran, and Gimpo remained pressure from outside the Seoul slots.
text.ko: 기지 면적은 2026년의 유치·정비 규모이며 붕괴 이후 가동량은 창작 설정이다. 서울 안의 여덟 기지는 신정·천왕·방화·군자·고덕·창동·신내·수서이다. 신정은 수문국, 천왕은 규격맹, 고덕은 동방사, 신내는 신내운수에 대응한다. 방화·군자·창동·수서는 무주지 또는 가장자리 회랑이며 마곡 연구·뚝섬 공방·창동 차륜·수서 보호의 수도 기지는 배치하지 않는다. 지축·도봉·모란·김포는 서울 슬롯 밖에 있다.

en.text: A depot was the seat of repair, bulk storage, and siege. Sinjeong's unloading and Godeok's train maintenance became a state's arms of legitimacy because the hands that moved a stopped train again or sent a convoy were there; Changdong's wheels and brakes lost their owner and remained only as leases in neighboring heads' ledgers. The drainage ponds became the water surface where tank aquaculture and migratory birds overlapped, and in the deep bays of maintenance sheds the sealing of looping chassis attached as a creative layer. ko.text: 기지는 수리·대형 저장·공성에 쓰인다. 신정의 하역 당직은 멈춘 열차를 다시 움직이고 고덕의 정비 당직은 호송을 보낸다. 창동의 차륜과 제동 장치는 이웃 수장의 장부에 임대로 남아 있다. 배수 연못에는 수조 농어와 철새가 있다. 정비고 깊은 칸에는 반복 기체가 봉인되어 있다. 충전 단자와 유압 호스의 수리 범위는

text.en: The industrial blocks of Guro and Geumcheon clung to the depots and used schools for drying parts, and the residential shells of Dobong and Nowon could not hold water without Changdong. Depot names were not raised to state names. The wheels and dispatch that people watched over became the state names.
text.ko: 구로·금천 공단 동에서는 기지와 붙은 학교를 부품 건조장으로 쓴다. 도봉·노원의 주거 쉘은 창동 기지의 급수가 끊기면 물을 유지할 수 없다. 국호에는 기지 이름 대신 사람이 맡은 차륜과 배차 업무를 쓴다.

text.en: On October 14, 2026, Yeongdeungpo waterworks officer Han Jeonghun operated valves manually after remote control failed. Under the March 14, 2053 agreement, Yeouido families took management of eleven water facilities near Yeongdeungpo Station. The waterworks staff moved their base to Yangpyeong Station underground on March 20.
text.ko: 2026년 10월 14일 영등포아리수정수센터 당직 책임자 한정훈은 원격 제어 두절 뒤 밸브를 수동으로 조작하였다. 2053년 3월 14일 협약으로 여의도 가문들이 영등포역 주변 급수 설비 11곳의 관리권을 넘겨받았다. 영등포 정수센터 측은 3월 20일부터 양평역 지하를 거점으로 삼았다.

en.text: On November 6, 2026, Han Jeonghun received two emergency-generator parts and agreed to open the water-pipe valve toward Yeouido every day. The transaction was recorded in
. Representatives of both sides also signed the March 14, 2053 transfer of water-facility management rights.

Yeouido, Ichon, Banpo, Jamsil, Mangwon, Hapjeong, Amsa, Guui, and Jayang were read as main-channel waterfront. en.text: Passages were the narrow lines where transfer, maintenance, and refuge overlapped. The transfer corridors were the hubs of politics and logistics between lines, and blockades, transit tolls, and congestion came first. The junctions where the Gangdong and Amsa ration corridors met the Eunpyeong and Seongbuk evacuation stairs became the warm nests of the rat colonies, and the fictional Sindorim junction split the main freight door from the maintenance passage that took only people and packloads, using siege as its stage. ko.text: 통로에는 환승·정비·피난이 겹친다. 환승 통로에서는 봉쇄·통행세·혼잡이 발생한다. 강동·암사 배급 통로와 은평·성북 대피 계단의 연결부에는 쥐 군락의 온열 둥지가 있다. 신도림의 창작 연결부는 주 화물문과 사람·등짐만 지나는 정비 통로로 나뉜다. 이 연결부 하나는 334역 카탈로그에 속하지 않는다. 신도림 사건의 장소는

text.en: The vertical connections were stairs, elevators, and ventilation shafts. Flooded floors showed cause and repair conditions and kept people out — that was the design. The Bukhansan Bogukmun mountain refuge roads, the Jegi-dong herb unloading, and the lower passages under the Noryangjin elevated joined the same graph from outside the stations. Connections were never deleted. Their states changed, and those states changed the times of rice, medicine, and convoys.
text.ko: 수직 연결은 계단·승강기·환기구다. 침수된 층은 원인과 복구 조건을 표시하며 출입을 막도록 설계하였다. 북한산보국문의 산악 피난로와 제기동 약재 하역장과 노량진 고가 아래 하층 통로는 역 바깥에서 같은 망에 연결된다. 연결을 삭제하지 않는다. 상태가 바뀌면 식량·약품·호송 시간이 바뀐다.

text.en: Garak, Gangseo, grain, and Noryangjin fish markets serve facilities around station hubs. Convenience stores and clinics remain local trades.
text.ko: 가락시장·강서시장·양곡시장·노량진 수산시장은 역 거점의 주변 시설이다. 가락시장은 가격 발견을 맡으며 생산지는 아니다. 노량진 수산시장은 냉동과 얼음 신용에 의존하므로 전력이 끊기면 냉동을 유지할 수 없다. 편의점과 의원은 역 주변 생업 시설로 남았다.
